verdicts.reason: Both share the same flaws: the phone illustration is jammed against the top-left edge and cropped, the top-right quadrant and the bottom ~120px are dead space, the subhead is indented at x≈105 on no clear axis, and the tilted 'ONLINE ONLY' badge sits awkwardly beside the CTA. A's one-line headline spans the width and shares a right edge with the subhead, so the stack at least reads as one block. B's two-line headline is left-aligned at x≈48 but the subhead starts at x≈105 and is wider than the headline, so neither its left nor right edges line up, and the headline crowds right up to the subhead.
